title: Page 5
transc:
Geo. W. Baldwin Balto.  Washington Feby 1st 1864
For Mr Garrett Prest Image and
Castor Soap period Vernon Lock wood 
is ordered to send Yoke to
Vermin Kelly Two Shylock and a
Robin are ordered from here signed
Abortion Martha what a disagreeable day


Washington Feby 2nd 1864
Geo Baldwin Balto
For Valley Lock = wood period
As you have for = warded
one Robin and one goes
from here I think they
will be sufficient unless others
should be asked for signed
Abortion Clara damp muddy here
